verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's official software stack documents GPU-optimized AI framework containers on NGC. It also documents cuML, which runs existing scikit-learn code on GPUs without code changes, and TensorRT-LLM for data-center model optimization. However, the pack never names PyTorch, never ties these builds to the H200 specifically, and shows no support or compatibility matrix. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX official builds, an H200 compute-capability support matrix, independent hands-on corroboration of frameworks running on H200.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices

citations.quote: Deploy the latest GPU optimized AI and HPC containers, pre-trained models, resources and industry specific application frameworks from NGC
cuML includes an API (cuml.accel) that can run your existing scikit-learn, UMAP, or HDBSCAN code on GPUs with no code modifications.
DeepSeek models can be optimized for performance using TensorRT-LLM for data center deployments.
